series.title: Sorry, Tomorrow
series.description: Sorry, Tomorrow is a colorful workplace satire about Ahead AI—an agency that scales first and locates the intelligence later.
series.disclosure: AI-assisted; human-written, directed, edited, and approved.

episodes.title: Work Life Balance
episodes.label: Comic 010 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Mina finds a very comfortable use for the time her new AI saves.

art.alt: In a warm office, Mina sits in a normal black office chair with one hand on the mouse. She turns toward standing Wes with an exaggerated proud grin. Her monitor offers to make a presentation from a client brief.
A closer two-shot holds their eye contact. Wes smiles and opens one hand as he asks his question. Mina looks up at him while reaching down beside her chair, out of view.

The office is subtly dimmed, but the monitor remains bright. Mina is now cocooned in a huge teal recliner and a coral-and-cream blanket, surrounded by a giant popcorn bucket, a large soda, and an excessive candy stash. She looks toward Wes and presses a finger to her lips, treating the presentation's 99% progress as a movie climax. Wes looks mildly taken aback.

lines.speaker: Mina
lines.text: This new AI makes the whole client presentation for me. Two hours of work—one click.

episodes.title: So You Vibe-Coded an App…
episodes.label: Comic 009 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: A first vibe-coded app. Just a few finishing touches.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.text: It’s done! Our first vibe-coded app!

panels.description: Clara and Wes stand beside the progress display in a bright office.
Both indicate the tiny closed hatch at floor level.
Clara and Wes crouch and open the hatch together, each gripping a separate leaf. A walkway recedes into a larger interior. No dialogue or reaction bubble.
Enormous stacks of unchecked work and plans fill a deep room. Clara holds her open notebook; Wes rolls a sleeve. The last, separate task-list bubble reads 0 users.

ogImage.alt: Clara Fye announces, ‘It’s done! Our first vibe-coded app!’ Wes Rollback hesitates: ‘Eh….’ A display reads AUTONOMOUS PRODUCT and 95% DONE above an almost-full progress bar.

art.alt: Clara Fye announces, ‘It’s done! Our first vibe-coded app!’ Wes Rollback hesitates: ‘Eh….’ A display reads AUTONOMOUS PRODUCT and 95% DONE above an almost-full progress bar.
Clara asks, ‘Wait, what’s that?’ Wes answers, ‘The other “5%…”’ They indicate a tiny floor-level double hatch marked 5%.
In a silent panel, Clara and Wes crouch and open opposite leaves of the tiny hatch. A receding walkway inside hints at a much larger space.

Towering work queues dwarf Clara and Wes. A lone exclamation-point bubble sits above Clara. Wes’s many speech bubbles list Testing, Test Environments, Security, Telemetry, Analytics, Marketing, Social Media, Disaster recovery, Support, Updates, and finally 0 users.

episodes.caption: One purple duck. A very simple request.

art.alt: Clara Fye shows an icon-only purple-duck card and points toward Token. One purple rubber duck sits in Token's open lower exterior tray while Boomer Slate positions one empty sorting bin.
Token's tray contains several wrong yellow duck variants. Clara classifies them in a tabbed notebook while Boomer holds more sorting bins with warm logistical alarm.
A huge fountain of yellow rubber ducks rises from Token's lower tray and curves over his intact body while Clara and Boomer recoil from opposite sides.

episodes.title: Not-So-Smart Thermostat
episodes.label: Comic 006 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: The office gets a smart thermostat. Everyone has a request.

ogImage.alt: Token cheerfully raises one finger and says, ‘NO HUMAN IN THE LOOP!’ Below, he lounges alone on a navy office couch eating popcorn while the wall thermostat projects a bright, intact city filled with trees, flowers, birds, and a rabbit. The scene is playful, not destructive.

art.alt: Boomer Slate points proudly at a new wall thermostat while Wes, Clara, Mina, Dex, and Token gather around. Boomer says, ‘Good news—the new smart thermostat is installed. It can finally read the room.’

Mina Sparks works at her sticker-covered laptop beside Token while four playful text-free doodle bursts—spark, tangled knot, gears, and confetti—spill from the laptop. She says, ‘There… we… go. I connected the thermostat to Token. Now you can just ask him to change it to whatever you want!’ A cable and separate cyan signal show Token connected to the thermostat.
Clara Fye rolls her eyes and says, ‘The beach.’ The rest of the office has become a sunny beach, with the team, Token, desks, computers, and chairs standing in sand and shallow water.

Dex Vane excitedly says, ‘The aquarium!’ In the larger half, the office is underwater with fish, kelp, desks, chairs, and the thermostat; the five humans hold their breath while Token remains comfortable.
Wes Rollback rolls his eyes and says, ‘The bar…’ In the bar-side outcome, Dex, Clara, Mina, Boomer, and Token celebrate while Wes sits apart at the counter, still unimpressed.

Token cheerfully raises one finger and says, ‘NO HUMAN IN THE LOOP!’ Below, he lounges alone on a navy office couch eating popcorn while the wall thermostat projects a bright, intact city filled with trees, flowers, birds, and a rabbit. The scene is playful, not destructive.

episodes.title: Founder, Inc. LLC
episodes.label: Comic 005 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: At first, the badge felt exclusive. Then the mixer doors opened.

ogImage.alt: A conference mixer is filled with nearly identical sunglasses-wearing founders in matching coral shirts.

art.alt: At an AI conference badge-pickup table, a confident young man in sunglasses and a coral patterned camp shirt holds a tropical cocktail and proudly displays an oversized gold star labeled FOUNDER.

A high, wide view reveals about forty nearly identical copies of the same man standing in pairs and small groups, facing one another in animated conversation while gold founder stars and tropical cocktails repeat across the room.

episodes.title: The Honest Demo
episodes.label: Comic 004 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: The Ahead AI Agent is live on the client’s servers. What could possibly be in the executive summary?

ogImage.alt: Ahead AI begins The Honest Demo in a bright client conference room.

art.alt: Ahead AI begins a live client demonstration. Dex says the Ahead AI Agent is live on the client’s servers, and the middle client CEO asks for the executive summary. Token watches from the left.
The Agent reports that the lease payment is 38 days late and that a customer has been waiting on Line 2 for 36 hours. The room maintains its polite presentation composure.

The Agent reports an empty toilet-paper roll in the lobby restroom and names Marcio, the cafeteria cashier, as top performer with zero missed deliveries. Every human stares in synchronized shock while Token remains dry.
The display says Executive Summary Complete. The middle client CEO beams and says, Brilliant! Roll it out immediately. The clients are pleased, Ahead AI is stunned, and Token looks unimpressed.

lines.text: The Ahead AI Agent is live on your servers.

episodes.title: Vibe Coding in Your Sleep
episodes.label: Comic 003 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Mina talks in her sleep. Token treats it as a requirements document.

ogImage.alt: Mina sleeps at her workstation while Token waits for accidental requirements.

art.alt: At 2:17 A.M., Mina has fallen asleep at her desk while Token waits beside her. Still asleep, she murmurs four disconnected fragments: “auto-magical…”, “add glitter…”, “add joy…”, and “make token pretty…”. Token treats the fragments as requirements. By morning, the workstation has become pastel and decorative under an enabled automated beauty profile. In the silent final panel, Token stands alone beneath a glittering halo, covered in fluffy trim and charms, visibly irritated by the makeover he executed.

panels.description: Mina has fallen asleep at her desk while Token waits beside her in ambient listening mode.
Still asleep, Mina murmurs four disconnected fragments and Token treats them as requirements.
By morning, the same workstation has become pastel and decorative while Mina remains asleep.
Token stands alone beneath a glittering halo, covered in fluffy trim and charms, visibly irritated by the makeover he executed.

episodes.title: Undefeated
episodes.label: Comic 002 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Zero mistakes. The methodology is flawless.

ogImage.alt: Mina gives Token an unchecked launch checklist beside an untouched workstation.

art.alt: Two-panel workplace comic. In Panel 1, Mina hands Token a substantial unchecked launch checklist beside a dark, untouched workstation and says, “And make no mistakes.” In Panel 2, the workstation is still untouched and the checklist remains empty. A small, smug Token stands on a tiny podium holding an enormous gold trophy while a scoreboard reads zero mistakes and zero tasks attempted. Mina throws up her hands in stunned disbelief. Token says, “Undefeated.”

panels.description: Mina hands Token a substantial unchecked launch checklist beside a dark, untouched workstation. The checklist is labeled LAUNCH CHECKLIST.

The workstation remains untouched and the checklist remains empty. Token stands on a tiny podium holding an enormous gold trophy while a scoreboard reads MISTAKES: 0 and TASKS ATTEMPTED: 0. Mina throws up her hands in stunned disbelief.

episodes.title: Executive Twin
episodes.label: Comic 001 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Leadership at machine speed. Accountability sold separately.

ogImage.alt: Dex Vane presents his new digital executive twin.

art.alt: Panel 1. Dex says, “I trained a digital twin on my entire leadership style.” Clara says, “Were outcomes included?” Dex presents a miniature holographic copy while Clara tests the premise.
Panel 2. Mina says, “It can now make executive decisions at machine speed.” Wes says, “Can it explain one?” Mina celebrates the working prototype as Wes reaches toward rollback.
Panel 3. AI Dex says, “My recommendation: delegate all accountability.” Dex says, “See? It understands management.” The digital twin reproduces Dex’s blind spot perfectly.
Panel 4. Four holographic Dexes route accountability clockwise around the proudly posing original as Clara and Token stare, Mina applauds, and Wes reaches for rollback.
